CONTEXT:
- Project: NorthGuard. Tech: TypeScript strict + Vitest.
- Current state: US-013 (ledger append + AF-403 governance writer) and US-002/003/004 (extract, stability, confirm) are done. This story activates a confirmed, stable policy version.

TASK:
Implement US-005 (AF-205 mode assignment, AF-206 guarded+logged activation). Activation is the ONLY thing that unlocks inspection/forwarding.

CREATE FILES: per manifest.create. Signatures exactly per specs/EP-02-policy-intake/APP-FUNCTIONS.md (AF-205, AF-206).

RULES:
1. TDD first.
2. NG-3: guardActivation MUST throw ActivationBlockedError when the area set is unstable, invalid, or has an unassigned mode. There is no force path.
3. NG-12: writeActivationGovernanceEvent MUST write to the ledger (E4 AF-403) BEFORE publishActivePolicy runs. If the ledger write fails, activation aborts.
4. publishActivePolicy retires any prior active version; with no active policy, inspection refuses to forward (fresh-install lock).
5. Import AF-403 read-only; do NOT modify the ledger package (protected).
6. Default area mode is 'redact' if unset (conservative but usable).
7. Report tests after each pair; final summary must show a blocked-activation test AND a successful activation writing a governance entry.
